prerequisites: Uncommitted C4L, C4M1, C4M2 and C4N retained.
scope: Public view-specific future material pipeline preparation, opt-in CPU encoding diagnostics and measured registration limits. Not production performance, exact visible registration, default-show migration or photographic approval.

api.supported: Rendered Camera3d sprite/trail/flipbook pipelines; mesh/ribbon/extension requests fail explicitly.
api.limits: Last extracted active view configuration; pipeline readiness only, not texture residency, simulation readiness or device admission. Dynamic material replacement requires a new request. No fake playback, seeks, particle buffers or gameplay events.

diagnostics.transport: Bounded latest CPU command-encoding frame; no GPU wait/readback/timestamps.
diagnostics.limits: Not a GPU completion fence, exact display timestamp or proof of visible pixels. Reports sample latest frames, not every render frame.

method.cost_lane: No screenshots/scans; identical optional CPU encoding ledger and schedule checks. Host intervals include vsync and are not isolated GPU timings.
method.image_lane: Separate experimental runs; asynchronous 8/15/17.45/25/32s requests, not exact-frame references.
method.source_inventory: Provenance inputs and shared qualification sources; not a minimal host dependency closure.

encoding_ledger.scope: CPU command encoding only; asynchronous latest frame, no GPU completion fence or visible-pixel assertion. Stateful quantization up to one simulation tick is expected.

report.scope: Actual public-window HDR/bloom/environment show. Real-time forward playback, asynchronous screenshots/counts. Image lane adds readback/scans and is not a cost lane. Host intervals are not GPU completion or exact display-present timestamps. No automatic adoption or photographic approval.

rejected_budget_experiment.policy: Particle-only coupling used the existing 300 exact/24 preview tick allowance, domain pacing unchanged. Reverted after poor pacing and flash delivery.
rejected_budget_experiment.summary: Four no-image lanes: zero late pipelines and maximum sampled encoding lag one tick, but p95 45.562-62.675ms, p99 325.307-347.392ms, max up to 513.164ms. Real/game totals diverge, high flash admits 9 versus 13. Not accepted. Both image lanes have one unattributed global pending update; OIT image lane 1368 capacity observations, zero drops/invalid links.
rejected_budget_experiment.bright_image_review: Ordinary request 17.550s and OIT 17.533s show the same broad three-burst phase and dark broken smoke. Both show zero currently active burst lights. Asynchronous requests and changed pacing prevent exact visual-registration or photographic approval; rejected candidate images only.
